summary: Shoot for the stars. This is what we tried to do for this challenge. Figuratively, you are the ones that try to do it literally. Our idea was to train two autoencoders and use the reconstruction error to calculate the most similar locations in Earth using the data from the Moon and Mars. The problem was that we haven’t used the APIs before and we really didn’t have a lot of time to learn to use them properly, so this is a concept.
details: A lot is explained in the repository’s README. Because the project is in the idea phase, there is no demo or intended impact because it would all be theoretical. The tools we used to try to obtain the data were python with multiple libraries. If an autoencoder were to be implemented, we would have used python.
